Meeting Date:                 11/16/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Burnett (27)
Type:                         Ordinance
Titie:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 1-J at 643-645 N Lawndale
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                     ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF GHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District synribols and indications as
shown on Map No. 1-J in the area bound by:

      a line 175 feet south of and parallel to West Huron Street; the alley next east of and
      parallel to North Lawndale Avenue; a line 125 feet south of and parallel to West Huron
      Street; and North Lawndale Avenue,

tb those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          /alter Burnett Jr.
                                                         Alderman, 27«' Ward




Common Address:
643-645 N. Lawndale Avenue
